caption: The drawing consists of a repeating pattern composed of stylized floral motifs arranged in a diamond lattice formation. The background is a medium blue-green color with evenly spaced vertical black lines. Each diamond is defined by white and blue leaf-like garlands forming the diamond borders, with white and light blue four-petal clusters with black centers marking the lattice intersections. Inside each diamond, there is a pale plant with light blue stems, white and ivory leaves, and stylized white flowers. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the pattern repeating both horizontally and vertically.
title: Wall Paper
